in_sanskrit.name: Hrudya
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Heart, Mind
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Hrudya एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Hrudaya means 'heart' or 'mind'. In Hindu mythology, Hrudaya refers to the innermost essence of an individual. It symbolizes the deepest emotions and thoughts, and is often used as a term of endearment and love.
